title: Visit to the Pantex pits
summary: John Herrington tells of Visit to the Pantex pits, about 1980s at Texas (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and and I've been in Pantex. I've been down in the pits.

plain: John Herrington, who was US Secretary of Energy in the 1980s, the head of the department in charge of the country's nuclear weapons work, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he has been inside the Pantex plant in Texas, a government nuclear weapons site. He says he has been "down in the pits" there. He mentions it to show he had firsthand access to the country's most secret sites.
